scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.check: npm run format:check && node --check scripts/run-stress.mjs && npm --prefix backend run check && npm --prefix frontend run check
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.security:audit: npm audit --audit-level=moderate && npm --prefix backend audit --audit-level=moderate && npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=moderate
